title: Animated Ads vs UGC Ads: Which Should You Test?
summary: Compare animated ads and UGC ads by proof, trust, control, cost, product type, and funnel stage, then run a fair two-format test.
body_markdown:
## Compare cost, speed, control, and trust


Real creators can provide lived perspective but require briefing, rights, scheduling, and possible reshoots. AI UGC offers fast variation but needs identity, claim, and artifact review. Animation offers visual control but may require more direction. Calculate cost per approved ad, not per generation.


## Why campaigns use both


A creator can state the problem, a product demo can prove the action, and animation can explain the mechanism. Retelling a winning angle in a new format can also refresh creative without abandoning the underlying strategy.


## Run a fair two-format test


Hold the audience, angle, promise, proof, offer, CTA, landing page, and campaign conditions constant. Produce UGC and animated executions of the same brief. Document unavoidable differences and evaluate attention, comprehension, clicks, conversion, and economics.
